# Routes

Part of the **Inventory** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List routes

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/routes`

Retrieve a paginated list of routes with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: suppliedWarehouse, supplierWarehouse, warehouses, company, creator, rules | `company,warehouses` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by | `architecto` |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by route name | `MTO` |
| `filter[company_id]` | string | No | Filter by company IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[product_selectable]` | string | No | Filter by product selectable state | `1` |
| `filter[product_category_selectable]` | string | No | Filter by category selectable state | `1` |
| `filter[warehouse_selectable]` | string | No | Filter by warehouse selectable state | `1` |
| `filter[packaging_selectable]` | string | No | Filter by packaging selectable state | `0` |
| `sort` | string | No | Sort field | `-created_at` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/routes?include=company%2Cwarehouses&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=MTO&filter%5Bcompany_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Bproduct_selectable%5D=1&filter%5Bproduct_category_selectable%5D=1&filter%5Bwarehouse_selectable%5D=1&filter%5Bpackaging_selectable%5D=0&sort=-created_at" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]

  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/routes?include=company%2Cwarehouses&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=MTO&filter%5Bcompany_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Bproduct_selectable%5D=1&filter%5Bproduct_category_selectable%5D=1&filter%5Bwarehouse_selectable%5D=1&filter%5Bpackaging_selectable%5D=0&sort=-created_at', [

## Create route

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/routes`

Create a new route

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Route name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `product_category_selectable` | boolean | No | Whether this route can be applied to product categories. |
| `product_selectable` | boolean | No | Whether this route can be applied to products. |
| `packaging_selectable` | boolean | No | Whether this route can be applied to packaging. |
| `warehouse_selectable` | boolean | No | Whether this route can be applied to warehouses. |
| `warehouses` | integer[] | No | Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/routes" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "MTO: Buy",
  "company_id": 1,
  "product_category_selectable": true,
  "product_selectable": true,
  "packaging_selectable": false,
  "warehouse_selectable": true,
  "warehouses": [
    16
  ]
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/routes", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "name": "MTO: Buy",
  "company_id": 1,
  "product_category_selectable": true,
  "product_selectable": true,
  "packaging_selectable": false,
  "warehouse_selectable": true,
  "warehouses": [
    16
  ]
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/routes', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'name' => 'MTO: Buy',
    'company_id' => 1,
    'product_category_selectable' => true,
    'product_selectable' => true,
    'packaging_selectable' => false,
    'warehouse_selectable' => true,
    'warehouses' => [
      16,
    ],
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/routes"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

payload = {
    "name": "MTO: Buy",
    "company_id": 1,
    "product_category_selectable": True,
    "product_selectable": True,
    "packaging_selectable": False,
    "warehouse_selectable": True,
    "warehouses": [
        16,
    ],
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```
